globalEvents.title: FAILURE
globalEvents.message:
The naked hatred of our enemies has made the construction of the Malevelon Creek Interrogation Center for Human Rights impossible. This great project, which would have honored our fallen heroes, has been stolen from our citizens. The graves of those who made the greatest sacrifice have been freshly trampled by this unforgivable series of transgressions.

Funding issues have unfortunately forced the Records Department to erase the bottom 10% of fallen heroes from their records, affecting all soldiers with last names beginning with letters Y and Z.

The cancelation of the project has had a significantly negative impact on citizen morale, leading to a sharp decrease in enlistment rates. Helldiver reinforcements will be heavily decreased for the duration of the following campaign.

globalEvents.title: ASSURANCE
globalEvents.message: Seditious false rumors regarding TCS+ malfunctions are spreading amongst civilians. SEAF Intelligence confirms any perceived structural failures are in fact scheduled mechanical upkeep, and not Terminid breaches. There is zero actionable peril to fully insured citizens. However, the resulting entirely unfounded economic panic in the run-up to Liberty Day, affecting all enterprises other than the hygiene paper industry, must be quelled. To restore public confidence, the Helldivers are ordered to eliminate 700,000,000 Terminids. To aid in swiftly safeguarding Federal prosperity, High Command has authorized and subsidized fleetwide availability of the INCINERATOR FRV Stratagem.
